400|     def __repr__(self):
401|         # Host comes first as it's the most common differentiator by far
402|         bits = [("host", self.host)]
403|         # TODO: maybe always show user regardless? Explicit is good...
404|         if self.user != self.config.user:
405|             bits.append(("user", self.user))

444|     def derive_shorthand(self, host_string):
445|         user_hostport = host_string.rsplit("@", 1)
446|         hostport = user_hostport.pop()
447|         user = user_hostport[0] if user_hostport and user_hostport[0] else None
448| 
449|         # IPv6: can't reliably tell where addr ends and port begins, so don't
450|         # try (and don't bother adding special syntax either, user should avoid
451|         # this situation by using port=).
452|         if hostport.count(":") > 1:
453|             host = hostport
454|             port = None
455|         # IPv4: can split on ':' reliably.
456|         else:
457|             host_port = hostport.rsplit(":", 1)
458|             host = host_port.pop(0) or None
459|             port = host_port[0] if host_port and host_port[0] else None
460| 
461|         if port is not None:
462|             port = int(port)
463| 
464|         return {"user": user, "host": host, "port": port}
